_notes: Detailed reference catalog of ~350 standard goods (types) for an Iranian B2B marketplace. Each good is a distinct product TYPE — not a category and not a SKU. Matching uses keywords (OR) + must_match_any_keyword_group (every group needs >=1 match) + excludeKeywords (disqualify).

_schema.aliases: alternative Persian names (also boosted in matching)
_schema.keywords: tokens that must appear in product text to match (OR logic, >=1)
_schema.must_match_any_keyword_group: array of groups; every group needs at least one keyword match
